literal.prompt: Как обычно запускали партию на коммерческом аркадном автомате 1970–1980-х годов?
answers: Запускали игру на домашней приставке Atari VCS
Вставляли сменный картридж в портативную консоль

literalGroups.primaryGround: The current answer describes a commercial coin-operated game (Nintendo L156; Atari L364-L367). The wrong answers name distinct, real home/portable alternatives: Atari VCS moved games from arcades into homes (Atari L409), Game Boy used interchangeable cartridges (Nintendo L175), and Game & Watch was a portable LCD videogame (Nintendo L152). Only the coin route answers for a commercial arcade machine.
literalGroups.locator: Atari L409; Nintendo History L152, L156, L175.

literalGroups.literal: Чтобы начать игру на коммерческом аркадном автомате, игрок вносил монету. Nintendo описывает Donkey Kong (1981) как coin-operated video game; хроника Atari связывает основание компании в 1972 году с опытом её создателей в coin-operated games.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The historical evidence distinguishes the coin-operated commercial arcade model (Nintendo L156; Atari L364-L367) from home console distribution (Atari L409).

literalGroups.literal: Atari VCS перенесла видеоигры из аркадных залов в дома; за первый год продали почти 400 тысяч консолей.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Atari says the VCS was the first console to bring games out of arcades and into the home and records nearly 400,000 first-year sales.
literalGroups.locator: Atari L409: VCS brought video games out of arcades and into homes; L409 also records first-year sales.

literalGroups.literal: Nintendo представила Game Boy в Японии в 1989 году вместе со сменными игровыми картриджами.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Nintendo says the Game Boy launched in Japan with interchangeable game cartridges in 1989.
literalGroups.locator: Nintendo History L175: Game Boy with interchangeable game cartridges introduced in Japan in 1989.

literalGroups.literal: В 1980 году Nintendo начала продавать в Японии Game & Watch — первые портативные LCD-видеоигры с микропроцессором.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Nintendo says its Game & Watch line began in 1980 as portable LCD videogames with a microprocessor.
literalGroups.locator: Nintendo History L152: Game & Watch portable LCD videogame line introduced in Japan in 1980.

literalGroups.literal: Donkey Kong (1981) стал хитом: Nintendo называет его самым продаваемым отдельным автоматом с оплатой монетами.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Nintendo identifies Donkey Kong as coin-operated and describes it as the hottest-selling individual coin-operated machine.
literalGroups.locator: Nintendo History L156: Donkey Kong (1981) described as coin-operated and the hottest-selling individual coin-operated machine.

correctNoteNewFact.whyAdditional: The prompt/key identify inserting a coin; this note adds a specific historical example and sales fact about the same coin-operated option.

absoluteDifficulty.audienceAndReasoningGround: This asks a familiar everyday distinction between a commercial pay-per-play arcade cabinet and home/portable game systems. The answer follows from general adult knowledge of coin-operated arcades and needs no niche date or multi-step reasoning; the wrong choices are real, recognizable video-game formats.
